verdict.rationale: Slack documents and exposes a public Web API (with live probe confirming the endpoint responds), an Events API for real-time push, a CLI, and SDK/Bolt tooling, giving AI-native developers multiple documented ways to programmatically drive the product. Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent third-party corroboration beyond Slack's own docs.
